classification.difficultyReason: Translate the remaining-yard context into the rectangle's area minus the triangular pool and square patio areas. All required dimensions and the perpendicular triangle height are supplied.

inlines.text: A backyard is a rectangle with dimensions
A triangular swimming pool with a base of
is constructed in one section, and a square patio with a side length of
Calculate the remaining area of the yard to the nearest whole square metre.

spec.description: Rectangular backyard with a square patio near the upper right and triangular pool near the lower left. The pool has a dashed perpendicular height.
spec.mathematics: Backyard 18 m by 12 m; square patio side 5 m; triangular pool base 6 m and perpendicular height 4 m.
spec.answerVisibility: All dimensions and region names are permanent givens; no calculated areas are visible.

answer.worked:
Subtract the pool and patio areas from the backyard area.
$$\begin{align*}
A_{\text{yard}} &= 18\times12\\
A_{\text{yard}} &= 216\text{ m}^2\\
A_{\text{pool}} &= \frac{6\times4}{2}\\
A_{\text{pool}} &= 12\text{ m}^2\\
A_{\text{patio}} &= 5\times5\\
A_{\text{patio}} &= 25\text{ m}^2\\
A_{\text{remaining}} &= 216-12-25\\
A_{\text{remaining}} &= 179\text{ m}^2
\end{align*}$$
